summary: Short residential kerb, homes 12 m behind, steep and timed no-parking.
reasons: Homes 12 m away on same side

best_section.where: McCaul Street south kerb, west of the bend

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwelling 12 m on the section's own side; more homes within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb with a grass verge; cars park on the opposite kerb, room for a van.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; timed no-parking sign (7-9 AM, Mon-Fri 2-5 PM) points left along this stretch.

flags: Timed no-parking sign 8 m from the kerb line
sun_shade: Open kerb; trees to the south-west and house shade the afternoon.
